evidence.title: AI Business Challenge Fes 2026 | SAJ B Sports

name: AI Business Challenge Fes 2026
summary: Japanese AI business competition event: free entry, three categories, online and in Tokyo on December 14, 2026.
description: Event page for AI Business Challenge Fes 2026, a "B Sports" AI competition organised by SAJ (Japan Software Association) on Dec 14, 2026, 15:00–17:30 JST, hybrid from the Tameike-Sanno area of Tokyo and online. Three competition categories: AI service development (bonus points for domestic AI such as Sakura's AI ENGINE), AI service proposal (plan/presentation decks, videos allowed) and a real-time battle with topics revealed on the day; entry is free and open to students, professionals, individuals and teams.
contains: format: hybrid — Tameike-Sanno area, Tokyo and online
three categories: AI service development, AI service proposal, real-time battle
free entry; open to any age, education or affiliation, individuals or teams
bonus points for domestic AI services such as Sakura's AI ENGINE
pre-submitted work due Sep–Nov 2026, judging early Dec
all applicants get SAJ support for sales, job hunting and team PR
